verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly promote React Native/Expo for building true native iOS/Android apps reusing React skills, and claim native look/feel and performance, but React Native is a separate framework/toolchain rather than React itself shipping mobile capability, and no independent performance benchmarks or hands-on native-app evidence are included. Missing for 10: independent verification of native performance parity, details on code-sharing limits between web and native, and hands-on developer reports building real mobile apps.
